name: Scallops with Cilantro-Lime Butter, Cheddar Potatoes & Veggies

instructions.primary_message: Preheat oven to 450°F. Coat a baking dish with a thin layer of butter.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
¾ lb new potatoes
½ lime
½ small bunch cilantro
1 medium carrot
1 (8 oz) pkg sugar snap peas

instructions.primary_message: Thinly slice potatoes crosswise and transfer to the baking dish; season with salt and pepper, then spread out in an even layer. Place in the oven and roast, tossing halfway through, until potatoes are tender, about 20 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
¼ tsp salt
⅛ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, coarsely grate cheese into a small bowl, then add bread crumbs and Italian seasoning. Stir to combine the cheese topping and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
¼ (8 oz) block cheddar cheese
2 tbsp panko bread crumbs
1 tsp Italian seasoning

instructions.primary_message: Zest and juice lime into another small bowl.
Peel and mince garlic. Shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add both to the bowl with the lime and set aside.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, pat the scallops dry with paper towels and place on a plate; season with salt and pepper on both sides.
instructions.secondary_message:
¾ lb sea scallops
¼ tsp salt
¼ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Once the skillet is hot, add butter and swirl to coat the bottom. Add scallops and sear until golden brown and cooked through, 1½-2 minutes per side. Remove to a clean plate and loosely cover with aluminum foil.
Meanwhile, peel, trim, and slice carrot crosswise into thin rounds.

When the potatoes are tender, remove from the oven, and sprinkle with the cheese topping. Return to the oven and continue to bake until the cheese is melted and golden, about 5 minutes. Remove from oven.

When the scallops are done, wipe the skillet clean with paper towels and return to medium-high heat; add more butter and swirl to coat the bottom. Add carrot, snap peas, salt, and pepper; sauté until the veggies are fork-tender, 4-5 minutes. Add to the plate with the scallops.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 tsp butter, unsalted
¼ tsp salt
⅛ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Return the skillet to medium heat, add more butter, and swirl to coat the bottom. Add lime, garlic, and cilantro; cook, stirring constantly, until butter is melted and fragrant, about 1 minute. Remove from heat.
To serve, divide cheesy potatoes, veggies, and scallops between plates; drizzle scallops with warm cilantro-lime butter and enjoy!
